note: Vendored builds that are not npm packages. scripts/licenses.ts checks each licence and every file's SHA-256.

components.name: libav.js decode-only variant 'cutframe' (T14 WASM software decode fallback)
components.licenseEvidence: FFmpeg 9.0 configured without --enable-gpl / --enable-nonfree: config.h has FFMPEG_LICENSE "LGPL version 2.1 or later" and CONFIG_GPL 0 (vendor/libav/ffmpeg-license.txt). libav.js's LICENSE.md says LGPL and that builds carry their licence headers: the .wasm.mjs header holds the LGPL 2.1 text, the Independent JPEG Group notice (ProRes/MJPEG IDCT) and libav.js's own permission notice. Only configuration was changed (vendor/libav/config.json); upstream patches are applied unmodified. Review F8 added FFmpeg's TIFF decoder and zlib 1.3.2 (Deflate TIFF; zlib licence, permissive, notice carried in the .wasm.mjs header).

components.name: Roboto 2.137 Regular and Bold (T08 motion-graphic sandbox font)
components.licenseEvidence: Each file's name table: Version 2.137; 2017, Copyright 2011 Google Inc., licence URL http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 (Bold also carries 'Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0'). vendor/roboto/LICENSE-2.0.txt is the unmodified Apache License 2.0 text. Apache-2.0 is compatible with AGPL-3.0. Bold is the fixture store's byte-identical copy of the face Xapp's font catalogue loads (fixtures/Cutframe test fixtures (C).md, Fonts); Regular is the Google Fonts v29 file of the same version.

components.name: d3-interpolate-path 2.3.0, ported to TypeScript (T08 interpolatePath for command lists that differ)
components.licenseEvidence: The npm package d3-interpolate-path 2.3.0 declares BSD-3-Clause; its LICENSE, copied unmodified to vendor/d3-interpolate-path/LICENSE, is the 3-clause BSD text (Copyright 2016, Peter Beshai). The port apps/web/src/mg/interpolate-path.ts (SPDX AGPL-3.0-only AND BSD-3-Clause) carries the full notice in a /*! @license */ block, which esbuild keeps in sandbox.generated.js (legalComments: 'inline'). BSD-3-Clause is compatible with AGPL-3.0. Remotion's interpolatePath docs: 'Source code stems mostly from d3-interpolate-path.'

components.name: Noto Color Emoji 2.057, COLRv1 (T05 text font chain, loaded lazily)
components.licenseEvidence: The font's name table: Version 2.057 (noto-emoji 20260911), Copyright 2022 Google Inc., licence description (name ID 13) 'This Font Software is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1', licence URL (name ID 14) http://scripts.sil.org/OFL. vendor/noto-emoji/OFL.txt is the unmodified 2D/fonts/LICENSE of the same tag (the OFL 1.1 text). OFL-1.1 is accepted for vendored font files only (scripts/licenses.ts, coordinator ruling Q6 of 3 Nov); a font shipped as separate font software is compatible with AGPL-3.0 (fixtures/Cutframe test fixtures (C).md, Fonts).

node_modules/@mediabunny/ac3.reason: The package declares MPL-2.0 and ships only an MPL-2.0 LICENSE, but embeds a WASM build of FFmpeg's AC-3/E-AC-3 coders (README build recipe: no --enable-gpl, so FFmpeg's LGPL-2.1-or-later applies). No FFmpeg notice or source ships with the package (open question in the T14 notes).
